//: No SPA catch-all rewrite: scripts/prerender.mjs emits a real dist/<route>/index.html for every route, so Vercel serves each one directly. Anything genuinely unmatched falls through to dist/404.html with a true 404 status, instead of the 200-with-index.html that Search Console flags as a soft 404.
//trailingSlash: Redirects /about/ to /about so a page has exactly one URL, rather than two that Google has to reconcile as duplicates. cleanUrls is deliberately NOT set: the prerender output is already extensionless directories, and its /404.html -> /404 redirect would only get in the way of Vercel's own 404 handling.

headers.//: Bundled assets carry a content hash in their filename, so a given URL's bytes never change and can be cached permanently.
HTML is regenerated every deploy and must never be served stale, or visitors keep booting an old bundle.
